subject.title: [Bug] Silent fail-open when Tailscale interface binding fails on gateway start

question: Should an explicitly configured `gateway.bind: "tailnet"` fail gateway startup when no Tailscale IPv4 is available, or remain available on loopback as a compatibility fallback?
rationale: Both outcomes are defensible: fail-fast honors the explicit bind contract and makes operator failure visible, while loopback fallback preserves local availability during transient or restricted interface discovery failures.

options.title: Fail explicit Tailnet binds
options.body: Reject startup with a clear Tailscale diagnostic only when the operator explicitly selected `tailnet`, while leaving automatic bind and discovery paths tolerant.

options.title: Keep fallback with warning
options.body: Continue listening on loopback but emit a prominent degraded-state warning and expose the resolved bind mismatch through status and health output.

options.title: Add a strictness setting
options.body: Preserve fallback by default and add an opt-in fail-fast setting, at the cost of another compatibility-sensitive configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Fail explicit Tailnet binds
recommendation.body: Reject startup with a clear Tailscale diagnostic only when the operator explicitly selected `tailnet`, while leaving automatic bind and discovery paths tolerant.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway bind and authentication history plus the issue mention make steipete the strongest available owner for this compatibility decision.
